_comment: Quality baseline: one full-tree violation count per tool. A baseline only goes down; raising a count needs the owner. Compared by brownfield-recipes/dev/quality_baseline.py from make format-check, typecheck and docs-lint. The coverage floor lives in .coveragerc (fail_under).

ruff.what: ruff check diagnostics over brownfield-recipes (rules in ruff.toml)

mypy.what: mypy --strict errors over the typed scope in the Makefile (TYPED_SOURCES)

markdownlint.what: markdownlint-cli2 issues over every tracked Markdown file (the DOCS_LINT_PATHS ratchet is a subset and clean)
